answers.value: Year 8: the allowance is debited $70,000 to reverse part of the prior LIFO-reserve build-up, with the credit to Cost of Goods Sold. COGS decreases by $70,000, so gross profit and pretax income each increase by $70,000.

notes: Allowance is trued up to the year-end LIFO reserve (FIFO EI - LIFO EI) each Dec 31, with the change run through Cost of Goods Sold. Year 6 +15,000 and Year 7 +10,000 build the reserve (Dr COGS); Year 8 reverses 70,000 (Dr Allowance, Cr COGS). FIFO COGS = LIFO COGS - change in reserve. Given Jan 1, Year 6 allowance of 120,000 is the Dec 31, Year 5 reserve and is the starting point of the Year 6 change.
